clare (docs): quick flag I pushed a tiny fix to an SDK snippet in docs/guides/migrate-v2.md and CI failed the preview job. logs show an import error for a parsing lib only used in the snippet test.

mike (eng): can you paste the error? might be the pinned deps in docs/requirements.txt conflicting with the action runner.

clare (docs): ci log: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pydantic-core'` even though we pin pydantic in requirements.

ci-bot: docs-preview failed  job id 9023  error: missing pydantic-core during autodoc build.

jenna (devex): we've seen pydantic-core split issues on py3.11. We run actions on 3.11 but local devs often on 3.9/3.10. Suggest adding a quick `docs-smoke` job that runs `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt` in the action matrix to catch this before full preview.

mike (eng): agreed. Minimal smoke step: install requirements then `python -c "import pydantic_core"` to fail fast. I'll draft.

sam (platform): also, this explains auto-merge behavior: branch protection currently treats `docs-preview` as optional so the bot merged when unit tests passed. We should tighten protection for docs-related paths.

clare (docs): yes please. For CODEOWNERS, some migration docs aren't owned by docs team which delays reviews. I propose adding `/docs/guides/migrate-*.md @clare-docs @devex`.

jenna (devex): small wrinkle: making docs-preview required will make lots of small doctypo PRs wait longer. Could we gate only PRs that touch `docs/guides/*` or contain `migration` in path to require the check? GitHub branch protection doesn't do path-level required checks. Alternative: update the auto-merge bot to require the `docs-preview` status when the PR touches docs/* and label `docs-change`.

mike (eng): good point. We can update the auto-merge workflow to check `paths` and then require both `docs-smoke` and `docs-preview` statuses before merging. Easier than branch protection changes.

sam (platform): I can update the auto-merge rules in the platform repo. Will add a conditional: if files_changed match `^docs/` then require `docs-smoke` and `docs-preview`.

clare (docs): action items: (1) mike to add docs-smoke step and a snippet test; (2) jenna to open CODEOWNERS addition PR for migrate guides; (3) sam to update auto-merge rules to be path-aware; (4) I'll re-run the preview after the smoke step is added.

mike (eng): pushing a branch with smoke job now. snippet: ```yaml
- name: Docs smoke
  run: |
    pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
    python -c "import pydantic_core"
```

ci-bot: queued rerun for PR #1256  awaiting new workflow run.

clare (docs): thanks all  I'll hold off merging until checks are stable and we have CODEOWNERS change.

jenna (devex): one more thought: add a short CONTRIBUTING note to call out recommended local python versions and `make docs-serve` to reduce CI surprises. I can draft that in the same CODEOWNERS PR.

mike (eng): +1. quick wins.

sam (platform): queued the auto-merge update for review; security will approve path rule.

clare (docs): perfect  closing the loop here once CI green. :thumbsup:
